title: Titanium Cardiovascular Stent
alloyReason: Nitinol (Nickel-Titanium Shape Memory Alloy, ASTM F2063) provides unique superelasticity and shape memory effect, enabling self-expanding stents, kink-resistant guidewires, and deployable medical devices. Its elastic recoverable strain (up to 8%) is orders of magnitude higher than any conventional metal.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)
Thread damage from improper installation torque exceeding recommended values
Galvanic corrosion at interface with dissimilar metals in electrolyte environments

faq.q: What is a titanium cardiovascular stent?
faq.a: A titanium cardiovascular stent is a precision-machined cardiovascular component used in self-expanding cardiovascular stent (nitinol). Manufactured from Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is titanium cardiovascular stent delivered?
faq.a: Titanium Cardiovascular Stent (Nitinol) is manufactured in its expanded shape, compressed into its delivery catheter, and self-expands at body temperature (37C) upon deployment. Fatigue testing exceeds 400 million cycles (10-year equivalent).

faq.q: How is titanium cardiovascular stent manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Cardiovascular Stent is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium cardiovascular stent?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium cardiovascular stent?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
